lead: A field added to `nvs_types::Env` builds clean and fails `--all-targets`.
body: There are three construction sites and one (`crates/nvs-types/src/lower.rs`) is inside a `#[cfg(test)]` module, so `cargo build -p nvs-types` is green while `cargo check -p nvs-types --all-targets` is the first thing that reports `E0063: missing field`. The two real sites are `check.rs`'s per-file loop and `signatures.rs`, which wants a scratch value because its pass runs before anything fills the new table.
